question:
Study the given diagram carefully and answer the question. The numbers in different sections indicate the number of persons.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fbc7c16e1e2b65e58b8f19ddf7a6fb17ae2221ac3076cff222ec32196182b531.png] 

How many such persons are there who are paediatricians and also orthopaedic surgeons but NOT physicians?
solution:
• The shaded part represents paediatricians and also orthopaedic surgeons but NOT physicians.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6ae0b966a68262e09e71d7ad0979b195852062b1773afa4b34a25dcc92e3afc1.png] 

 
• The number representingpaediatricians and also orthopaedic surgeons but NOT physicians = 11

**Hence, ‘11’ is the correct answer.**
